$schema.description: Optional path or URL of gbscore.schema.json, for editors.

rowsPerBeat.description: Rows per beat; 4 makes a row a sixteenth note.

grid.description: For display only. Never changes the sound.

groove.description: Ticks per row, cycling every 4 rows. The game ticks at 60.24 Hz.

loop.description: The row the song loops back to after its last row.

instruments.description: Pulse lanes use duty instruments; the wave and noise lanes use their own.

waves.description: Wave shapes for the wave channel.

id.description: The number wave instruments and the wave effect use (0–15).

name.description: A label for people; never changes the sound.

patterns.description: Reusable runs of notes. A lane item with `pattern` plays one at its row.

pulse1.description: Pulse channel 1, with duty instruments. The only one with pitch sweep.

wave.description: The wave channel, with wave instruments.

noise.description: The noise channel, with noise instruments. Higher notes are higher-pitched noise.

lanes.description: One lane per Game Boy sound channel. Items sort by row.

global.description: Song-wide effects. The compiler puts each on a lane with a free effect slot.

id.description: The number notes use to pick this instrument (1–15).

name.description: A label for people; never changes the sound.

duty.description: Duty cycle: the pulse width, from thin (12.5%) to hollow (50%).

envPace.description: Envelope pace: ticks of 1/64 s per volume step. 0 holds the volume.

sweepTime.description: Pitch sweep pace (pulse 1 only). 0 turns the sweep off.

sweepShift.description: Pitch sweep step size: each step changes the period by period / 2^shift.

length.description: Length counter: the note lasts (64 − length) / 256 s when enabled.

lengthEnabled.description: Whether the note stops by itself after `length`.

table.description: Runs one row per tick from the start of each note. After row 31 it goes back to row 0, unless a row jumps. Missing rows at the end are empty.

note.description: Semitones from the playing note. Omit to leave the pitch alone.

jump.description: After this row, continue at this table row instead of the next one.

TableRow.description: One tick of an instrument table.

arp.description: 0xy: arpeggio, cycling the note, +x and +y semitones each tick.

slideUp.description: 1xx: slide the pitch up by xx units per tick.

slideDown.description: 2xx: slide the pitch down by xx units per tick.

glide.description: 3xx: glide toward this row's note by xx units per tick (tone portamento).

vibrato.description: 4xy: vibrato with speed x and depth y.

duty.description: 9xx on pulse lanes and duty tables: set the duty cycle.

wave.description: 9xx on the wave lane and wave tables: switch to wave n.

volSlide.description: Axy: retrigger the note with its volume raised by x and lowered by y.

volume.description: C0v: set the volume (0–15) and restart the note. The wave channel has 4 levels.

cut.description: Exx: cut the note at tick xx of this row.

delay.description: 7xx: start this row's note xx ticks late.

raw.description: An effect as tracker hex, e.g. "9D0". Only for values the named effects can't express, such as duty bytes with length bits.

Effect.description: One effect: an object with exactly one key.

id.description: The number notes use to pick this instrument (1–15).

name.description: A label for people; never changes the sound.

length.description: Length counter: the note lasts (256 − length) / 256 s when enabled.

lengthEnabled.description: Whether the note stops by itself after `length`.

table.description: Runs one row per tick from the start of each note. After row 31 it goes back to row 0, unless a row jumps. Missing rows at the end are empty.

id.description: The number notes use to pick this instrument (1–15).

name.description: A label for people; never changes the sound.

envPace.description: Envelope pace: ticks of 1/64 s per volume step. 0 holds the volume.

length.description: Length counter: the note lasts (64 − length) / 256 s when enabled.

lengthEnabled.description: Whether the note stops by itself after `length`.

table.description: Runs one row per tick from the start of each note. After row 31 it goes back to row 0, unless a row jumps. Missing rows at the end are empty.

id.description: The name placements use: 1 to 32 characters, no spaces at either end, unique in the song.

kind.description: The instruments its notes use. A duty pattern goes on either pulse lane.

length.description: Length in rows. Every item starts before it and every note ends by it.

items.description: Notes and effects, as in a lane, with rows from the pattern start.

Pattern.description: A run of notes for one lane, placed on the timeline by lane items with `pattern`.

row.description: Row in the pattern, counting from 0 at the pattern's start.

len.description: Notes: rows the note lasts; it is cut when they end. Placements: rows it plays, cutting its last repeat short.

note.description: Note name, C3 to B8 (A5 is 440 Hz). Omit for an effect without a note.

inst.description: Instrument number. Every note needs inst, or legato. On a placement, the instrument its pattern's notes play with.

legato.description: Change pitch without restarting the note: no new attack, and the previous note's instrument, envelope and table carry on. Pulse and noise lanes only; on noise it also returns to 15-bit mode.

fx.description: An effect on this row. Notes can't use cut; use cutTick.

cutTick.description: End the note at this tick of its last row, instead of when the row after it starts.

PatternItem.description: A note or an effect in a pattern, as in a lane.

row.description: Row on the song timeline, counting from 0.

len.description: Notes: rows the note lasts; it is cut when they end. Placements: rows it plays, cutting its last repeat short.

note.description: Note name, C3 to B8 (A5 is 440 Hz). Omit for an effect without a note.

inst.description: Instrument number. Every note needs inst, or legato. On a placement, the instrument its pattern's notes play with.

legato.description: Change pitch without restarting the note: no new attack, and the previous note's instrument, envelope and table carry on. Pulse and noise lanes only; on noise it also returns to 15-bit mode.

fx.description: An effect on this row. Notes can't use cut; use cutTick.

cutTick.description: End the note at this tick of its last row, instead of when the row after it starts.

pattern.description: Places the pattern with this id here. A placement has no fields but row, transpose, repeat, inst and len.

transpose.description: Placements only: semitones added to the pattern's notes.

repeat.description: Placements only: how many times the pattern plays, back to back. 1 if left out.

LaneItem.description: A note (row, len, note, inst or legato), an effect without a note (row, fx), or a placed pattern (row, pattern, transpose, repeat, inst, len).

row.description: Row on the song timeline, counting from 0.

tempo.description: Fxx: every row from here takes this many ticks, so the groove becomes uniform.

pan.description: 8xx: which speakers pulse1, pulse2, wave and noise play on.

GlobalItem.description: A song-wide effect: row plus exactly one of tempo, pan or masterVolume.
